allocation_impact: raw_length is checked against 16 MiB and against 1,024 times compressed_length before decompression; decompression writes into exactly raw_length bytes and the output must be exactly that long. The compressed frame is bounded by the file size.
boundary_tests: a payload is accepted at a reduced sector_raw_bytes cap equal to the largest raw_length (ReadCaps), and rejected at one byte less
raw_length over 16 MiB is rejected before decompression
raw_length over 1,024 times the frame length is rejected before decompression
a frame that decompresses to a length other than raw_length is rejected
notes: MAP-BUNDLE-1a; ADR-0021 §4.2 and §4.8; format document §9. Matches the B3 codec MAX_SECTOR_BYTES; ratio limit 1,024:1.
resource: Decompressed payload of one sector, with its zstd frame as the compressed size
